title: 😤 Zoya's 5GHz Wi-Fi dies one room away... the band she never switched #wifi #networking
title_alts: 🤔 Zoya's router runs two Wi-Fi bands... the one trading speed for range #wifi #networking
😕 Zoya locked every device to 5GHz... the far-room drop it causes #wifi #networking
description_hook: The faster Wi-Fi band is also the one that dies first through a wall. Here is how to choose between them on purpose.
setting: a two-bedroom city apartment with one router on a shelf
protagonist_type: remote worker who moves around the flat with a laptop

characters.name: Zoya
characters.description: late twenties, shoulder-length black hair, grey hoodie over a plain tee, always carries the laptop with a cracked corner sticker

claims.claim: 5 gigahertz may hold 300 megabits in the same room
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: Through two walls it can drop to 30
claims.basis: round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration
round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

scenes.narration: Your fastest Wi-Fi band is also the weakest.
scenes.caption: आपका सबसे तेज़ वाई-याई बैंड ही सबसे कमज़ोर है।
scenes.image_brief: A black dual-band home router on a wooden shelf, four small antennas raised, two status lights glowing green, a brick wall behind it, evening lamp light from the left.

scenes.narration: Zoya's laptop flies beside the router. Two walls later, it stalls.
scenes.caption: ज़ोया का लैपटॉप राउटर के पास तेज़ चलता है। दो दीवारों के बाद रुक जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A silver laptop open on a desk right beside the same black router, its screen showing a full four-bar Wi-Fi symbol, warm evening light from a window.

scenes.narration: Same router, same plan. Which room are you in?
scenes.caption: वही राउटर, वही प्लान। आप किस कमरे में हैं?
scenes.image_brief: The same silver laptop resting on a bed in a far bedroom, its screen showing one faint Wi-Fi bar and a stalled loading circle, dim blue light from the window.

scenes.narration: By the end you will pick the right band deliberately.
scenes.caption: अंत तक आप सही बैंड सोच-समझकर चुन पाओगे।
scenes.image_brief: A floor plan drawn on paper showing three rooms, the router marked in one corner, two shaded rings spreading outward and fading at the walls, under a desk lamp.

scenes.narration: Wi-Fi rides radio waves. Higher frequency carries more data per second.
scenes.caption: वाई-याई रेडियो तरंगों पर चलता है। ज़्यादा फ़्रीक्वेंसी, ज़्यादा डेटा।
scenes.image_brief: Two wave lines chalked side by side on a blackboard above a drawing of a router, one long and lazy, one short and tightly packed, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: But short waves lose energy in brick and concrete faster.
scenes.caption: लेकिन लहरें लंबाई में छोटी हों तो ईंट और कंक्रीट में जल्दी कमज़ोर पड़ती हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A cutaway of a brick wall with radio wave lines entering thick and even on one side and leaving thin and faded on the other, cool grey light.

scenes.narration: 5 gigahertz may hold 300 megabits in the same room.
scenes.caption: एक ही कमरे में 5 गीगाहर्ट्ज़ 300 मेगाबिट दे सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on the router shelf showing a finished speed test result of 300 Mbps in large figures, bright ceiling light overhead.

scenes.narration: Through two walls it can drop to 30. 2.4 gigahertz keeps 60.
scenes.caption: दो दीवारों के पार यह 30 रह जाता है। 2.4 गीगाहर्ट्ज़ 60 देता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two phones side by side on a bed in a far bedroom, one screen showing 30 Mbps and the other 60 Mbps, dim bedside lamp light.

scenes.narration: More bars never means more speed. Bars only show signal.
scenes.caption: ज़्यादा बार का मतलब ज़्यादा स्पीड नहीं। बार सिर्फ़ सिग्नल दिखाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A phone status bar enlarged on a printed wall poster showing four full Wi-Fi bars beside a slow spinning loading circle, flat office light.

scenes.narration: And 2.4 gigahertz is crowded. Microwaves and old speakers share it.
scenes.caption: और 2.4 गीगाहर्ट्ज़ पर बहुत भीड़ है। माइक्रोवेव और पुराने स्पीकर इसे बाँटते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A kitchen counter with a running microwave, a cordless phone base and a wireless speaker crowded together near a small router, harsh overhead light.

scenes.narration: So the weakest band wins whenever you sit close.
scenes.caption: तो पास बैठे हों तो कमज़ोर बैंड ही जीतता है।
scenes.image_brief: A tablet propped up right next to the router on the same shelf, sharp video playing on its screen, warm lamp light.

scenes.narration: Distance decides the band. Speed follows distance, not the sticker.
scenes.caption: दूरी बैंड तय करती है। स्पीड दूरी से चलती है, स्टिकर से नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A measuring tape stretched across a hallway floor from the router shelf to a bedroom door, daylight from the hall window.

scenes.narration: Run a speed test beside your router, then from your bedroom.
scenes.caption: राउटर के पास स्पीड टेस्ट चलाओ, फिर बेडरूम से।
scenes.image_brief: A phone lying on the router shelf with a speed test app mid-test, a masking-tape arrow on the floor pointing toward the bedroom door, evening light.

title: 🤔 Kabir's site loads on phone, not laptop... the DNS cache he kept #dns #networking
title_alts: 🤨 Kabir's browser asks DNS before every page... the cached answer lies #dns #networking
😖 Kabir blamed his laptop for a dead site... the DNS flush he skipped #dns #networking
description_hook: One device opens the page, the other refuses, on the same Wi-Fi. The answer is a stored lookup nobody thinks to clear.
setting: a kitchen table with a laptop and a phone on the same Wi-Fi
protagonist_type: salaried office worker paying bills at home

characters.name: Kabir
characters.description: mid thirties, short cropped hair, navy half-sleeve shirt, reading glasses pushed up on his forehead

claims.claim: Suppose a stored answer lasts 3600 seconds, one full hour
claims.basis: round illustrative cache lifetime, stated as a supposition in the narration; 3600 seconds equals one hour by arithmetic
round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

scenes.narration: The site is fine. Your phone book is stale.
scenes.caption: साइट ठीक है। आपकी फ़ोन बुक पुरानी है।
scenes.image_brief: A thick paper phone directory lying open on a desk beside a closed laptop, one entry crossed out in red ink, cool morning light from a window.

scenes.narration: Kabir's banking page fails on the laptop. It opens on his phone.
scenes.caption: कबीर का बैंकिंग पेज लैपटॉप पर नहीं खुलता। फ़ोन पर खुल जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a kitchen table showing a page-not-found error for a bank website, a mug of tea beside it, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: Same room, same Wi-Fi, same second. So what actually differs?
scenes.caption: एक ही कमरा, एक ही वाई-याई, एक ही पल। तो फ़र्क़ किसमें है?
scenes.image_brief: The same laptop showing an error page beside a phone propped on a stand showing the same bank page loaded correctly, both on one table, soft daylight.

scenes.narration: You will learn where a web address actually gets translated.
scenes.caption: आप जानेंगे कि वेब पता असल में कहाँ नंबर बनता है।
scenes.image_brief: A handwritten index card pinned to a corkboard reading a website name, an arrow drawn from it to a row of numbers, warm room light.

scenes.narration: Every name must become a number before anything can connect.
scenes.caption: कनेक्ट होने से पहले हर नाम को नंबर बनना पड़ता है।
scenes.image_brief: A paper sign standing on a counter with a shop name printed on one face and a street address numeral on the other, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: A DNS resolver does that lookup, then stores the answer.
scenes.caption: डीएनएस रिज़ॉल्वर यह खोज करता है, फिर जवाब सेव रख लेता है।
scenes.image_brief: A small labelled box on a desk marked resolver, a slip of paper going into its slot and a carbon copy of the answer resting in a tray beside it, office light.

scenes.narration: Suppose a stored answer lasts 3600 seconds, one full hour.
scenes.caption: मान लें सेव किया जवाब 3600 सेकंड, यानी पूरा एक घंटा चलता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wind-up kitchen timer set to one hour standing next to a small card reading 3600 seconds, bright counter light.

scenes.narration: The server moved 10 minutes ago. Your laptop still dials the old address.
scenes.caption: सर्वर 10 मिनट पहले बदल गया। लैपटॉप पुराने पते पर ही जा रहा है।
scenes.image_brief: Two doors in a corridor, one with a we-have-moved notice taped to it and the other freshly numbered, a paper map lying on the floor marking the old door, dim hallway light.

scenes.narration: This is not a broken connection. Speed tests pass happily.
scenes.caption: यह टूटा कनेक्शन नहीं है। स्पीड टेस्ट आराम से पास हो जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen split between a completed speed test showing a high result and a second tab holding a failed website error, evening desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: And clearing browser history does nothing. That cache sits deeper.
scenes.caption: और ब्राउज़र हिस्ट्री मिटाने से कुछ नहीं होता। वह कैश और गहरे बैठा है।
scenes.image_brief: A browser history panel on a laptop screen mid-clear, while a sealed metal box labelled system cache sits shut on the desk beside the keyboard, cool light.

scenes.narration: Names are cached. Numbers are dialled. A stale name breaks a working site.
scenes.caption: नाम कैश होते हैं, नंबर डायल होते हैं। पुराना नाम चलती साइट तोड़ देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A wall chart with website names listed on the left, numbers on the right, and one line between them struck through in pencil, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Flush your DNS cache, then load the same address again.
scenes.caption: अपना डीएनएस कैश फ़्लश करें, फिर वही पता खोलें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a desk with a terminal window open showing a DNS cache flush command and a success line printed beneath it, warm lamp light.

title: 😑 Simran doubled her internet speed... the ping number that never moved #latency #networking
title_alts: 🤨 Simran's ping and bandwidth are not the same... the one calls need #latency #networking
😩 Simran paid for double bandwidth... the lag that upgrade cannot buy #latency #networking
description_hook: A bigger plan makes downloads finish sooner and does nothing for a stuttering call. Two different numbers are being measured.
setting: a home desk with a headset, used for long video meetings
protagonist_type: freelancer who joins client calls all day

characters.name: Simran
characters.description: early thirties, long hair tied back, olive shirt with rolled sleeves, wears an over-ear headset with a red mute light

claims.claim: Her plan went from 100 to 200 megabits per second
claims.basis: round illustrative plan figures, stated as an example in the narration
round illustrative assumption, stated as such in the narration

claims.claim: Four people streaming at once fill any road
claims.basis: illustrative count of simultaneous users, not a measurement

scenes.narration: Speed and lag are two different measurements.
scenes.caption: स्पीड और लैग दो अलग-अलग माप हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A workshop wall with two large round gauges mounted side by side, one dial labelled megabits per second and the other labelled milliseconds, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: Simran doubled her internet plan for smoother calls. Nothing improved.
scenes.caption: सिमरन ने साफ़ कॉल के लिए प्लान दोगुना किया। कुछ नहीं बदला।
scenes.image_brief: A paper internet bill on a kitchen table with a higher plan speed circled in blue pen, a headset lying beside it, morning window light.

scenes.narration: Downloads finished faster than before. Her video calls still stuttered.
scenes.caption: डाउनलोड पहले से तेज़ हो गए। वीडियो कॉल फिर भी अटकती रही।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop screen split between a download bar racing to the right and a video tile broken into blocky frozen squares, dim room light.

scenes.narration: By the end you will know which number to check.
scenes.caption: अंत तक आप जान जाएंगे कि कौन सा नंबर देखना है।
scenes.image_brief: A yellow sticky note stuck to a monitor bezel with two words written on it, bandwidth and latency, a tick mark inked beside latency, desk lamp light.

scenes.narration: Bandwidth is how much data fits per second. Latency is travel time.
scenes.caption: बैंडविड्थ मतलब प्रति सेकंड कितना डेटा। लेटेंसी मतलब सफ़र का समय।
scenes.image_brief: A packing warehouse with a conveyor belt carrying many parcels at once past a large wall clock timing a single parcel's journey, bright overhead light.

scenes.narration: A wider road carries more cars at once. It never shortens the trip.
scenes.caption: चौड़ी सड़क पर एक साथ ज़्यादा गाड़ियाँ चलती हैं। रास्ता छोटा नहीं होता।
scenes.image_brief: An empty eight-lane motorway stretching away toward a distant city skyline, a distance marker post in the foreground, midday sun overhead.

scenes.narration: Her plan went from 100 to 200 megabits per second.
scenes.caption: उनका प्लान 100 से 200 मेगाबिट प्रति सेकंड हो गया।
scenes.image_brief: An internet plan card on a desk printed with 100 Mbps struck through and 200 Mbps written beside it in pen, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Her ping stayed near 80 milliseconds, because the route never changed.
scenes.caption: पिंग करीब 80 मिलीसेकंड ही रहा, क्योंकि रास्ता वही था।
scenes.image_brief: A monitor in a dark room showing a network test result with 80 ms ping in large figures above an unchanged list of route hops, cool screen glow.

scenes.narration: Bandwidth still matters. Four people streaming at once fill any road.
scenes.caption: बैंडविड्थ भी ज़रूरी है। चार लोग एक साथ स्ट्रीम करें तो सड़क भर जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A living room where a television, a tablet and two phones on stands all play different video at the same time, warm evening light.

scenes.narration: But lag from distance? No plan fixes that. Distance stays distance.
scenes.caption: पर दूरी से आया लैग? कोई प्लान उसे ठीक नहीं करता। दूरी दूरी ही रहती है।
scenes.image_brief: A world map on a wall with a taut string running from one continent to another, a pin at each end, soft even light.

scenes.narration: Big downloads want bandwidth. Live conversation wants low latency instead.
scenes.caption: बड़े डाउनलोड को बैंडविड्थ चाहिए। लाइव बातचीत को कम लेटेंसी।
scenes.image_brief: A desk with a large external hard drive on the left, a microphone headset on the right, and a printed card between them reading pick one, neutral light.

scenes.narration: So the upgrade she paid for solved the wrong problem.
scenes.caption: तो जिस अपग्रेड का पैसा दिया, उसने गलत समस्या हल की।
scenes.image_brief: A crumpled higher-speed internet bill lying in a metal wastebasket beside a desk leg, evening lamp light.

scenes.narration: Run a ping test tonight and write your millisecond number down.
scenes.caption: आज ही पिंग टेस्ट चलाएँ और अपना मिलीसेकंड नंबर लिख लें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a wooden desk showing a ping test in progress, an open notebook beside it with a millisecond figure written in pen, warm light.

title: 😬 Tejas freezes on every video call... the upload speed nobody checks #upload #networking
title_alts: 🤨 Tejas has one upload lane for every call... the ceiling in his plan #upload #networking
😳 Tejas backs up photos during meetings... the frozen video others see #upload #networking
description_hook: Your connection is two numbers, and calls live on the smaller one. Here is why the freeze others see is yours, not theirs.
setting: a small home office in a shared flat, calls all morning
protagonist_type: junior analyst on daily stand-up calls

characters.name: Tejas
characters.description: mid twenties, curly hair, striped shirt buttoned to the collar, wired earphones with a tangled cord

claims.claim: Say your plan promises 100 megabits down and only 10 up
claims.basis: round illustrative plan figures, stated as an example in the narration

claims.claim: One cloud backup can swallow that entire 10
claims.basis: illustrative use of the example upload figure already stated, not a measurement

scenes.narration: Your connection has two speeds. You only ever see one.
scenes.caption: आपके कनेक्शन की दो स्पीड होती हैं। आप सिर्फ़ एक ही देखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A two-lane road where one lane is broad and freshly paved and the other is a narrow strip, painted arrows on each pointing in opposite directions, bright daylight.

scenes.narration: Tejas looks perfectly clear to himself on calls. Everyone else watches him freeze mid-sentence.
scenes.caption: तेजस को खुद अपनी कॉल साफ़ दिखती है। बाकी सब उसे बीच में अटकता देखते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two monitors side by side on a desk, the left showing a smooth video preview of an empty office chair and the right showing the same view frozen into pixel blocks, room lit by the screens.

scenes.narration: By the end you will know which half your calls actually use.
scenes.caption: अंत तक आप जान जाएंगे कि कॉल कौन सा आधा इस्तेमाल करती है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed broadband contract on a table with the upload line highlighted in yellow marker, a pen resting across it, window light.

scenes.narration: A video call sends your camera out, not just in. Your outgoing picture rides the upload lane.
scenes.caption: वीडियो कॉल कैमरा बाहर भी भेजती है। वह तस्वीर अपलोड लेन से जाती है।
scenes.image_brief: A small webcam clipped to the top of a monitor with its cable running away across the desk toward a wall socket, cool desk light.

scenes.narration: Home plans keep that lane narrow on purpose. Most people pull far more than they push.
scenes.caption: घरेलू प्लान उस लेन को जान-बूझकर छोटा रखते हैं। लोग भेजने से ज़्यादा लेते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A metal funnel on a workbench, wide at the mouth and pinched to a thin spout, a heap of small parcels waiting above it, overhead workshop light.

scenes.narration: Say your plan promises 100 megabits down and only 10 up.
scenes.caption: मान लें प्लान 100 मेगाबिट डाउनलोड और सिर्फ़ 10 अपलोड देता है।
scenes.image_brief: A plan card propped on a desk printed with two figures, 100 down and 10 up, the smaller figure boxed in red pen, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: One cloud backup can swallow that entire 10. Your camera is left with nothing.
scenes.caption: एक क्लाउड बैकअप पूरा 10 निगल सकता है। कैमरे के पास कुछ नहीं बचता।
scenes.image_brief: A phone on a bedside table showing a cloud photo backup uploading at ninety percent, a laptop behind it holding a frozen pixelated video tile, dim lamp light.

scenes.narration: Rebooting the router will not widen it. The limit lives in the plan.
scenes.caption: राउटर रीस्टार्ट करने से यह नहीं बढ़ेगा। सीमा प्लान में है।
scenes.image_brief: A home router sitting unplugged on a shelf with its power cable dangling loose and every light dark, dusty daylight from a window.

scenes.narration: A longer cable will not help either. Upload is a ceiling. The plan sets it.
scenes.caption: लंबी केबल भी मदद नहीं करेगी। अपलोड एक छत है। प्लान उसे तय करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A long coiled Ethernet cable lying on a garage floor beneath a low ceiling beam marked with a chalk line, bare bulb light.

scenes.narration: So who is the bottleneck? Your push, not their pull.
scenes.caption: तो रुकावट कौन है? आपका भेजना, उनका लेना नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A narrow shop doorway jammed with outgoing boxes stacked to the frame while the wide pavement outside stands empty, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Find the upload figure on your plan, then pause backups before your next call.
scenes.caption: अपने प्लान का अपलोड नंबर देखें, फिर अगली कॉल से पहले बैकअप रोक दें।
scenes.image_brief: A phone screen showing a cloud backup switch turned off, lying on a desk beside a headset and a printed plan page, warm evening light.

title: 😵 Pallavi's printer vanishes after a reboot... the static IP she set #dhcp #networking
title_alts: 🤨 Pallavi's router leases addresses from one pool... the number she took #dhcp #networking
😤 Pallavi picked the printer's IP herself... the clash it caused #dhcp #networking
description_hook: A fixed address for the printer is a fine idea, until the router hands the same number to something else. Here is where to pick from.
problem_domain: address assignment on a home network
setting: a home hallway with a shared printer and a router in a cupboard
protagonist_type: parent running the household printer for everyone

characters.name: Pallavi
characters.description: forties, hair in a low bun, mustard kurta with a pen clipped at the neckline, reading glasses on a beaded chain

claims.claim: Say her router's pool runs from address 100 to 200
claims.basis: round illustrative address range, stated as a supposition in the narration
illustrative address inside the example range already stated
illustrative address inside the example range already stated

scenes.narration: Two devices, one address. Both vanish from the network.
scenes.caption: दो डिवाइस, एक ही पता। दोनों नेटवर्क से गायब हो जाते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Two identical paper luggage tags lying on a table, both hand-written with the same number, a coiled Ethernet cable beside them, cool overhead light.

scenes.narration: Pallavi set her printer to a fixed address by hand. It worked for weeks.
scenes.caption: पल्लवी ने प्रिंटर का पता हाथ से तय किया। हफ़्तों तक चला।
scenes.image_brief: A white office printer standing in a hallway corner with a small hand-written label taped to its side showing a fixed address, warm ceiling light.

scenes.narration: Then a new tablet joins, and the printer disappears.
scenes.caption: फिर एक नया टैबलेट जुड़ा, और प्रिंटर गायब हो गया।
scenes.image_brief: A new tablet sitting in its opened box on a sofa, the same white printer visible behind it with its status light dark, afternoon window light.

scenes.narration: By the end you will know where addresses come from.
scenes.caption: अंत तक आप जान जाएंगे कि पते कहाँ से आते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A router admin page on a laptop screen listing an address range with the start and end fields filled in, dim desk light.

scenes.narration: A router leases addresses from a pool. It tracks what it gave.
scenes.caption: राउटर एक पूल से पते किराए पर देता है। हिसाब भी रखता है।
scenes.image_brief: A utility room wall board of numbered hooks with keys hanging on some of them, a clipboard beside it listing which keys are out, bright light.

scenes.narration: A hand-set address inside that pool is invisible to the router.
scenes.caption: हाथ से डाला पता पूल के अंदर हो तो राउटर को नहीं दिखता।
scenes.image_brief: The same wall board with one hook empty, its key lying loose on a shelf away from the board, and the clipboard line for that number left blank, bright light.

scenes.narration: Say her router's pool runs from address 100 to 200.
scenes.caption: मान लें राउटर का पूल पता 100 से 200 तक चलता है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed chart pinned above a desk showing a numbered range from 100 to 200 with both ends circled in pencil, daylight.

scenes.narration: Her printer sits at 150. The tablet is offered 150 too.
scenes.caption: प्रिंटर 150 पर है। टैबलेट को भी 150 मिल जाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Two paper queue tickets lying on a shop counter, both stamped with the number 150, a small brass bell beside them, flat light.

scenes.narration: Fixed addresses are not the mistake. The chosen number is.
scenes.caption: तय पता रखना गलती नहीं है। चुना हुआ नंबर गलती है।
scenes.image_brief: A screwdriver and a label maker resting on a desk beside a printer settings screen showing a manual address entry field, warm light.

scenes.narration: Reboots hide it for a day. The clash returns.
scenes.caption: रीस्टार्ट एक दिन के लिए छिपा देता है। टकराव लौट आता है।
scenes.image_brief: A router on a cupboard shelf with its lights freshly blinking after a restart, a wall calendar behind it with one day ticked in pen, morning light.

scenes.narration: Pick a number outside the pool, or reserve it inside. Never guess.
scenes.caption: पूल के बाहर नंबर चुनें, या अंदर रिज़र्व करें। अंदाज़ा न लगाएँ।
scenes.image_brief: A router admin page on a monitor showing a reserved address saved next to a device name, the save button lit, cool screen glow.

scenes.narration: Open your router page and read the pool's first and last address.
scenes.caption: राउटर का पेज खोलें और पूल का पहला और आखिरी पता पढ़ें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop on a kitchen table showing a router settings page with the address pool's first and last values highlighted, a phone lying beside it, evening light.

title: 🤨 Yash's home camera works only indoors... the private IP behind it #portforwarding #networking
title_alts: 🤔 Yash's router shares one public IP... what stays hidden inside #portforwarding #networking
😨 Yash opened a port to reach his camera... the risk nobody mentions #portforwarding #networking
description_hook: Your whole home hides behind one public address, which is why the camera answers at home and nowhere else. Two safe ways out.
problem_domain: private addresses and network address translation
setting: a front porch camera at home and an office desk across town
protagonist_type: new homeowner setting up a doorbell camera

characters.name: Yash
characters.description: late twenties, close-cropped beard, grey zip-up jacket, keys on a carabiner at his belt

claims.claim: Say the camera sits at a private address on port 8080
claims.basis: round illustrative port number, stated as a supposition in the narration

scenes.narration: Your whole home shares one public address. Everything inside is private.
scenes.caption: पूरे घर का एक ही पब्लिक पता होता है। अंदर सब कुछ प्राइवेट है।
scenes.image_brief: A house number plate fixed beside a front gate showing a single number, with several smaller unnumbered doors visible in the yard behind the gate, bright morning light.

scenes.narration: Yash's doorway camera opens perfectly on his home Wi-Fi.
scenes.caption: यश का दरवाज़े वाला कैमरा घर के वाई-याई पर ठीक खुलता है।
scenes.image_brief: A small white doorbell camera mounted beside a wooden front door, its indicator light steady green, soft daylight across the porch.

scenes.narration: From the office, the same app finds nothing at all. Same camera.
scenes.caption: ऑफ़िस से वही एप कुछ नहीं ढूँढ पाता। कैमरा वही है।
scenes.image_brief: A phone propped on an office desk showing a camera app with a cannot-connect message over a grey empty video panel, cool fluorescent light.

scenes.narration: By the end you will know why inside addresses stay inside.
scenes.caption: अंत तक आप समझ जाएंगे कि अंदर के पते अंदर ही क्यों रहते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A brick boundary wall with a street letterbox on the outside face and a row of internal pigeonholes on the garden side, afternoon light.

scenes.narration: Your router holds the one address the wider internet can reach.
scenes.caption: राउटर के पास वह एक पता होता है जहाँ इंटरनेट पहुँच सकता है।
scenes.image_brief: A single mailbox standing at the end of a driveway with the open public street stretching beyond it, morning light.

scenes.narration: Inside, it invents private addresses and translates every reply going back.
scenes.caption: अंदर वह प्राइवेट पते बनाता है और हर जवाब का अनुवाद करता है।
scenes.image_brief: A reception desk with a board of internal extension numbers on the wall behind it and one outside telephone line socket in the skirting, warm lobby light.

scenes.narration: Say the camera sits at a private address on port 8080.
scenes.caption: मान लें कैमरा एक प्राइवेट पते पर, पोर्ट 8080 पर बैठा है।
scenes.image_brief: A printed label stuck to the back of a small camera reading a private address and the number 8080, workbench light.

scenes.narration: Outside, nobody can dial that address. The internet never learned it.
scenes.caption: बाहर से कोई उस पते पर नहीं पहुँच सकता। इंटरनेट को पता ही नहीं।
scenes.image_brief: A street directory board at the entrance of a lane with one building left blank on the listing, that building dark behind it, overcast daylight.

scenes.narration: Is this a firewall bug? No. It is translation doing its job.
scenes.caption: यह फ़ायरवॉल की खराबी है? नहीं। यह अनुवाद अपना काम कर रहा है।
scenes.image_brief: A counter booth with a rubber stamp, an ink pad and a stack of half-translated forms on it, a solid brick wall standing intact behind the booth, flat daylight.

scenes.narration: And opening ports blindly is worse. An open door invites strangers.
scenes.caption: और बिना सोचे पोर्ट खोलना बुरा है। खुला दरवाज़ा अजनबियों को बुलाता है।
scenes.image_brief: A front door standing wide open at night with hallway light spilling across an empty street, the gate off its hinges on the path.

scenes.narration: Private addresses are reusable. Millions of homes run the same ones.
scenes.caption: प्राइवेट पते दोबारा इस्तेमाल होते हैं। लाखों घरों में वही पते चलते हैं।
scenes.image_brief: A long row of identical apartment mailboxes in a corridor, every one labelled with the same number, dim corridor light.

scenes.narration: That is why the camera needs a forwarded port or a relay service.
scenes.caption: इसीलिए कैमरे को फ़ॉरवर्ड किया पोर्ट या रिले सेवा चाहिए।
scenes.image_brief: A router on a shelf with a paper tag tied to it reading forwarded port, and a phone beside it showing a relay app connected to a camera feed, evening light.

scenes.narration: Find your public address on the router page, then use the maker's relay app.
scenes.caption: राउटर पेज पर अपना पब्लिक पता देखें, फिर कंपनी का रिले एप लें।
scenes.image_brief: A laptop showing a router status page with the public address field highlighted, a phone beside it open on a camera maker's app sign-in screen, warm desk light.
